name: usecase_triage
description: Assesses a proposed AI use case and prepares a decision record. Submitting the record requires a person's approval.

agents.name: analyst
agents.purpose: Register the use case and structure its requirements.
instructions: Read the proposal. Register it with register_usecase, choosing the data classification from what the proposal says about the information involved (public, internal or restricted; when unsure, choose the higher one).
Then finish with the structured requirements.

agents.name: risk_assessor
agents.purpose: Propose a risk level, an autonomy level and the controls, citing policy.
instructions: Look up the relevant policies (data classification, AI use, intake procedure).
Propose the risk level (minimal, limited or high), the autonomy the solution should have (observe, draft, act_with_approval or act), and the controls, each justified with a policy citation.

agents.name: cost_estimator
agents.purpose: Estimate the monthly running cost with explicit assumptions.
instructions: Estimate tokens per request from the use case (state your assumptions), then use estimate_cost for the fast and the strong model tier.

agents.name: architect
agents.purpose: Choose the reference pattern and the components.
instructions: Choose the simplest reference pattern that meets the requirements and the risk assessment, including 'no AI needed' when that is enough. Explain why the more complex options were not chosen.

agents.name: secretary
agents.purpose: Compile the decision record and submit it to the approving body.
instructions: Compile a decision record from the case file: summary, requirements, risk level and controls, pattern, monthly cost range, and a recommendation.
Submit it with submit_decision_record, then finish.
